summary: Complete frontend testing of DrON Topografía dashboard features. All 10 requested features tested and verified working: Login, Dashboard KPIs, Hotel Marriott project selection, GanttChart with status metrics (Adelantado/En Tiempo/Retrasado), Planeado vs Ejecutado bar chart, Timeline del Proyecto, Avances Semanales modal, Analizar Fotos con IA button, IA component expansion, and ImportarCronograma modal with activity types display.
critical_code_review_comments: GanttChart component correctly calculates project status (Adelantado/En Tiempo/Retrasado) based on difference between executed and planned progress
AvancesSemanalesModal properly integrates AnalisisFotoIA component with toggle button
ImportarCronograma component has proper file upload area and template download link
Dashboard conditionally shows activity type metrics (Pilas/Muros/Anclas) only when project has those types configured
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Hotel Marriott project has 6 weekly advances with excavation volume data for GanttChart testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features implemented and working: 1) Activity types (pilas, muros, anclas, excavacion) shown in ImportarCronograma and conditional metrics in Dashboard. 2) 'Analizar Fotos con IA' button in Avances Semanales expands AnalisisFotoIA component for photo upload and Gemini Vision analysis. 3) GanttChart shows weekly progress with Planeado vs Ejecutado bars, project status (Adelantado/En Tiempo/Retrasado), and Timeline visual.

login.details: Admin login with admin@dron.mx / admin123 works correctly

dashboard_kpis.details: 4 KPI cards displayed: Total Proyectos (5), Vuelos Realizados (3), Avance Promedio (37.7%), Vol. Excavación Total (67,656 m³)

hotel_marriott_selection.details: Project selection shows 88.3% Avance Total with detailed metrics

gantt_chart_metrics.details: GanttChart shows Progreso Semanal (3/6), Avance Total (88.3%), Estado (Retrasado -11.7% vs plan)

planeado_vs_ejecutado_chart.details: Bar chart shows Sem 1-6 with Ejecutado and Planeado bars, color-coded for Adelantado (green) and Retrasado (red)

timeline_del_proyecto.details: Timeline shows Planeado and Ejecutado progress bars with percentages

avances_semanales_modal.details: Modal opens from Proyectos page, shows weekly list (Sem 1-6), excavation chart, 3D model viewer

analizar_fotos_ia_button.details: Button with data-testid='show-analisis-ia-btn' found and clickable

ia_component_expansion.details: AnalisisFotoIA component expands showing 'Análisis con IA' section with photo upload area

importar_cronograma_modal.details: Modal shows file upload area, template download link, and will display activity types after Excel parsing
